equipment.notes: MAC intake filter house, upwind, ~190 m from the vent area V1.
MAC train with gearbox and motor. Interstage nozzles on the north side towards the intercoolers (the P&ID draws them below the machine).
Intercooler 1, bundle pull to the west (roller door W1).
Intercooler 2, bundle pull to the west under the crane, clear of E-1101.

Aftercooler north-east of K-1101: bundle pull to the west under the crane, clear of the K-1101 motor removal space. Air nozzles on the shell top (the P&ID draws them at the ends, which would block the bundle pull).
MAC blow-off silencer outside the east wall of B1, outlet elevated. ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: MAC anti-surge blow-off silencer (UV-1102), outside the MAC house east wall, outlet elevated. Air: no zone. ASSUMED 1.6 m x 6 m.

equipment.notes: DCAC.
Evaporative cooler, clear of the 8 m wide rack PR1 and its columns with its foundation (1 m south, D-033 (6)).
DCAC CW pumps beside C-1101.
Chilled water pumps, suction towards the C-1102 sump, access space clear of the PR1 columns.
Horizontal adsorber. Feed air in and regeneration gas out at the bottom, dry air out and regeneration gas in at the top (the P&ID draws the vessel upright).
Electric regeneration heater; gas inlet on the west side 1 m up (the P&ID draws it below the heater, at grade).
Dust filter.
HP column on its skirt inside the cold box. Nozzles towards E-3101 / E-3102 (east) and LOX north to the rack.
LP column stacked on the HP column, E-3103 in its sump (D-028).

BAHX core bank on the cold box base slab in the middle bay of CB-1, warm end up; warm-end headers spread over the top in two rows (the P&ID draws them 0.8 m apart, closer than their diameters), cold-end headers on the column side (the P&ID draws them below the core).

Subcooler on the cold box support deck E20: inlet headers low on the south side (the P&ID draws them below the core), the rich liquid and LN outlets low on the north side towards the casing hatch H1, the waste N2 outlet on top (the P&ID draws them 0.4 m apart, closer than the DN800 waste N2 header).
equipment.service: Subcooler (rich liquid / LN against waste N2 and GAN)

equipment.notes: Expander end of the compander skid (same shaft as K-3101) against the cold box south wall, its cold end in the casing extension (D-023, D-029): inlet on top, exhaust north into the cold box.
Booster end of the compander skid, beside the expander: suction on top, discharge south to E-3104.
Booster aftercooler south of the compander, bundle pull to the west.
Drain vaporizer, outside the cold box west wall.

GOX compressor behind its fire/blast wall FW-4101, open to the east (EIGA Doc 27 practice, ASSUMED). Interstage and discharge nozzles on the north side towards the intercooler package and the aftercooler (the P&ID draws the interstage ones below and the discharge at the motor end).
Intercooler package north of the fire wall: four shells in two stacked pairs on one frame, drawn as its 6 x 2.8 x 3.2 m envelope (D-055 (6)).
GOX aftercooler, bundle pull to the west; GOX nozzles on the shell top (the P&ID draws them at the ends).
GAN compressor; discharge on the north side, not at the motor end (P&ID: right side).
GAN aftercooler; GAN nozzles on the shell top (the P&ID draws them at the ends).

LOX tank on a 0.5 m foundation plinth (ASSUMED, D-055 (5)): the bottom outlet N4 at 1.0 m, 0.35 m above the pump suctions, and the suction lines fall to the pumps. Bottom outlet towards the pumps (south). The boil-off vent PV-4109 / vacuum breaker (N2) and the relief valve PSV-4123 (N3) on the west side of the roof, away from the spiral stair, its landing and the roof platform on the east side (D-038 (2), review4#2).

LIN tank on a 0.5 m foundation plinth (ASSUMED, D-055 (5)): the bottom outlet N4 at 1.0 m, 0.35 m above the pump suctions, and the suction lines fall to the pumps. Bottom outlet towards the pumps (south). The boil-off vent PV-4110 / vacuum breaker (N2) and the relief valve PSV-4124 (N3) on the west side of the roof, away from the stair and the roof platform on the east side (D-038 (2), review4#2).
Suction to the north (tank), motor to the south.
LOX ambient-air vaporizer.
LIN ambient-air vaporizer.
GOX blowdown silencer with its outlet stack, 7.5 m, so its O2 zone stays above grade (D-033 (5)); 16 m from the north road R3. ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: GOX compressor blowdown silencer (XV-4116), in the vent area V1 (O2-enriched zone, D-013, D-019). ASSUMED 1.0 m x 5 m.

equipment.notes: GOX suction vent silencer with its outlet stack, 7.5 m (D-033 (5)). ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: GOX suction vent silencer (PV-4101B), in the vent area V1 (O2-enriched zone, D-019). ASSUMED 1.4 m x 6 m.

equipment.notes: Waste N2 surplus vent silencer, 10 m south of the O2 silencers. ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: Waste N2 surplus vent silencer (PV-3110B), in the vent area V1, outlet elevated (O2-deficient zone, D-011). ASSUMED 2.0 m x 8 m.

equipment.notes: LP column relief valve on the relief valve platform RV south of the roof walkway, 3.6 m from ladder LD8; tailpipe VNT-3002 straight up above the walkway headroom plus its zone radius (O2-rich, D-033 (1), review 2026-10-21-layout-rereview#1). ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: Outside the cold box, elevated (O2-rich: safe location, zone Z-O2-VENTS).

equipment.notes: HP column relief valve on the platform RV, 3 m from PSV-3114, tailpipe VNT-3003 up as VNT-3002. ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: Outside the cold box, elevated (N2, zone Z-N2-VENTS).

equipment.notes: TSA regeneration / depressurization vent silencer west of the adsorbers on its stack, outlet 10 m up, above the adsorber tops (6.5 m) and their zone reach (O2-deficient, D-033 (5), review 2026-10-21-layout-rereview#5). ASSUMED size.
equipment.service: TSA regeneration gas / depressurization vent silencer at the adsorbers (waste N2: O2-deficient zone Z-N2-VENTS).

notes: All dimensions ASSUMED (basic engineering). Distance F-1101 intake (25, 30) to the vent area V1 (centre 190, 124.5): about 190 m, downwind of the intake; O2 vents also >= 15 m (ASSUMED) from roads and ignition sources, N2 vents elevated above platforms (D-011, D-019, D-025). Spacing criteria as separations above; measured values in DESIGN.md D-030.

Only the MAC train is housed (noise ~85 dB(A) at 1 m, weather protection, crane for rotor and bundle pulls). The GOX compressor K-4101 stays in the open behind its fire wall FW-4101 (layout/structures.yaml) so that an O2 fire vents to atmosphere and nobody works in an enclosed room around it (D-012, D-026). Two personnel doors on opposite sides (S2, E3) give two ways out. The substation and control building B2 stands at the upwind west end of PR1, north of the MAC house and 120 m from the nearest O2 vent: the 6.6 kV MAC motor is fed close by (cable cellar and trench into B1), the other cables run to the plant on PR1, and no oxygen-enriched or inert zone reaches the occupied control room (D-036). B2 is 2 m from B1 behind its REI 120 south wall (declared separation, D-038 (6)). Its transformers TR-1 / TR-2 stand in the transformer yard on its west side (zones Z-TR1 / Z-TR2 with oil bunds, fire wall FW-TR between them, access from the west road R4; D-038 (7)).

E-3103 is the bath condenser inside the C-3102 sump and has no placement of its own (D-028). Silencers are placed by their tag of piping/special-items.yaml; relief valve outlets discharge at the item they protect (DESIGN.md section 4).
